result.target_topic: Amortization of Acquisition-Related Intangible Assets Increase
result.target_summary: Amortization of acquisition-related intangible assets recognized in operating expenses increased by $1,850 million, or 133%, in fiscal year 2024 compared to the prior fiscal year. This increase was primarily due to higher amortization of customer-related intangible assets resulting from the VMware Merger.

target_year_over_year_context.explanation: This disclosure reports the year-over-year change in amortization of acquisition-related intangible assets for 2024 (increase of $1,850 million, or 133%) and attributes it to the VMware Merger. There is no 2023 counterpart because the 2023 disclosures (D047, D048, D043) did not report this specific 2024 variance or the specific impact of the VMware Merger on the 2024 numbers (the merger closed in late 2023, so 2023 data would not show this full-year impact in the same way). This is a new specific topic/figure for 2024 with no 2023 equivalent.

comparisons.peer_summary: Amortization of acquisition-related intangibles was $2.4 billion for 2024, a decrease of 15% from $2.8 billion in 2023, primarily due to certain intangibles being fully amortized in the prior fiscal year.
comparisons.comparison: Both AVGO and AMD disclose the year-over-year change in amortization of acquisition-related intangible assets included in operating expenses. AVGO reported a significant increase of $1.85 billion (133%) driven by the VMware Merger, whereas AMD reported a decrease of $417 million (15%) as certain intangibles were fully amortized. While both companies highlight the impact of acquisition-related intangibles, the direction and magnitude of the expense change differ materially due to different M&A timelines and amortization schedules.

sentences.text: Amortization of acquisition-related intangible assets recognized in operating expenses increased $1,850 million, or 133%, in fiscal year 2024, compared to the prior fiscal year primarily due to higher amortization of customer-related intangible assets from the VMware Merger.
Amortization of acquisition-related intangibles of $2.4 billion for 2024 decreased by $417 million, or 15%, compared to $2.8 billion in 2023.
The decrease was primarily due to certain acquisition-related intangibles being fully amortized in the prior fiscal year.

comparisons.peer_topic: All Other operating loss breakdown for 2024 and 2023
comparisons.peer_summary: All Other operating loss was $4.2 billion in 2024 and $4.4 billion in 2023, primarily consisting of amortization of acquisition-related intangibles and stock-based compensation expense.
comparisons.comparison: AMD provides a breakdown of the components of 'All Other' operating losses, explicitly identifying the $2.4 billion amortization of acquisition-related intangibles as the primary driver, alongside stock-based compensation. This context aligns with AVGO's focus on amortization as a key operating expense item, but AMD's disclosure is broader, grouping amortization within a net loss category that includes other non-cash charges, whereas AVGO isolates the amortization figure.

sentences.text: Amortization of acquisition-related intangible assets recognized in operating expenses increased $1,850 million, or 133%, in fiscal year 2024, compared to the prior fiscal year primarily due to higher amortization of customer-related intangible assets from the VMware Merger.
All Other operating loss of $4.2 billion in 2024 primarily consisted of $2.4 billion of amortization of acquisition-related intangibles and $1.4 billion of stock-based compensation expense.
All Other operating loss of $4.4 billion in 2023 primarily consisted of $2.8 billion of amortization of acquisition-related intangibles and $1.4 billion of stock-based compensation expense.
